error.message: the quote is not in the text of Passage <passage>, so nothing was recorded. Evidence is the Source's own words: quote the Passage as the search gave it, never a paraphrase or a summary. Line breaks and other white space, a word cut at a line's end, another form of the same characters, and quotation marks and dashes of another shape may differ, and nothing else: not a word, not a letter's case. A quote that runs on into the next Passage names both, in order
